howtos.title: Audit every project when a new model ships
howtos.what: One prompt that has a coding agent find broken, inconsistent, inefficient or unneeded code, fix the sure things and list the rest.
copy: Read this entire project and find everything that’s broken, inconsistent, inefficient, or no longer needed. Fix what you’re sure about and list the rest for me to review.
howtos.whenToUse: Right after a new model release, run it on each project you own.

howtos.title: Explain the why, not the what, to your AI
howtos.what: In AI grilling sessions, describe the user problem instead of the feature you want built.
copy: State the problem, not the feature.
Bad: "I want to build an analytics panel for admins with graphs and filters".
Good: "Admins can't currently see an overview of the important data in the app".
howtos.whenToUse: When starting a planning or grilling session with a coding agent on a new feature.
